text_block_list.text:
I'm out in the courtyard during lunch<n>talking to Biwa
Hayahide, when...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you two! You seen Brian<n>anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, not today. Why do you ask? Did<n>something
happen?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's not a big deal or anything. I<n>made her
lunch, but forgot to give it to<n>her.
choice_data_list: You made lunch for Narita Brian?
You made lunch for Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yep. That girl is picky as heck, though.<n>There's only
a handful of things<n>she'll actually eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But I figure I can't just let her starve,<n>so I make
her lunch every now and<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My sister's diet is beyond<n>unbalanced, so your
efforts are<n>appreciated, Hishi.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I still remember the difficulties I faced<n>whenever I
used to make curry for<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She'd stop eating it altogether if she<n>detected even
a hint of vegetables, so<n>I had to try many
combinations until it<n>was just right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd have to mince and stew the<n>veggies for hours,
but once I<n>achieved the right taste, she couldn't<n>get
enough!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Wow, it's hard to imagine her<n>being so
spoiled now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well... That was quite some time ago.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As for these days, forget about<n>cooking―we hardly
even have the<n>chance to eat together at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I bet she'd still happily gobble up<n>your food. Why
not give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so... That was long ago,<n>and our
relationship isn't what it once<n>was.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We don't live together anymore, so<n>suddenly
pushing food upon her<n>would be rather awk—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, don't be nuts!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You think too much. You just gotta do<n>it! Act first,
and figure out the rest<n>later!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You and me—we're gonna cook up<n>somethin' after
school today. See<n>you in the cafeteria kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You better be there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't even have a chance to<n>object.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well... I can't simply ignore her, so I<n>suppose I'll
have to go.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to make something<n>that'll knock
Brian's socks off!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The question is, what should<n>that something
be?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Care to offer your thoughts on the<n>matter, Trainer?
choice_data_list: A nutritious curry to give her strength.
A thick hamburger steak to boost her stamina.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nice! That oughta bring back some<n>good memories
for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's been quite some time since I<n>made curry for
her. I hardly remember<n>the recipe anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot deny that curry is<n>a good choice.
Vegetables, meat, and<n>carbohydrates, all on one
plate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Although I don't recall the exact<n>recipe, I'll do my
best to replicate the<n>flavor.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...And, it's finished!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How curious, though. It's been years,<n>yet
somehow I remembered precisely<n>what to do at
every step.
choice_data_list: All that hard work really sunk in, huh?
All that hard work really sunk in, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That smell sure brings back<n>memories.

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
In the flesh... I knew this had to be my<n>sister's
curry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Mind if I tear in? I was just about to<n>scrounge up a
snack.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yep, that's Big Sis's curry, all right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll have seconds.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh! O-of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha! Look at that face!

Watching her little sister eat, Biwa<n>Hayahide can't
even begin to hide<n>her joy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm... An interesting proposal.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Stamina is essential for tempering a<n>strong body...
Hamburger steak it is,<n>then!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I do recall having<n>made
hamburger steak occasionally.<n>It wasn't always
curry, of course.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In fact, hamburger steak afforded me<n>an even
greater chance to sneak<n>some vegetables in
without her<n>noticing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I do the same thing! As long<n>as it still looks
and tastes like meat, it<n>usually passes the test.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian's palate is a lot simpler than<n>you'd think.

The two of them chat away as they<n>prepare a meal
for Narita Brian. Until...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And it's done! One stealthy<n>hamburger steak with
extra hidden<n>vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The veggies are mixed into the sauce,<n>too, as
opposed to just the—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You seem to be having a good time,<n>Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian?! Wh-what are you doing here...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Amazon told me to come. Apparently<n>there's
something you want me to<n>eat?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for not tellin' you... But since<n>you went
through all the trouble of<n>cooking, I wanted to make
sure it paid<n>off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Of course you did. Well, Isuppose the cat's out of the bag.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm, pretty good. Meat is the best. Itgives me energy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hehe, looks like it worked,<n>Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, so it did.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What are you two mumbling about?

The two of them keep Narita Brian<n>company as she
finishes off the<n>lovingly prepared hamburger steak.
